note: Redwood state park on the South Fork Eel River off Hwy 101, about 7 mi south of Garberville. Two family campgrounds, Huckleberry (sites 1-36) and Madrone (sites 37-76), sit under the redwoods west of the highway; the river, the swim beach and the visitor center are across Hwy 101. Showers are coin-operated. --Claude
summary: Richardson Grove SP: creekside -> not waterfront proposed (Hwy 101 and ~150-400 m between both loops and the river); $35 flat confirmed (2027 weekdays and Saturdays); 63 bookable units (Huckleberry 30 + Madrone 33; stored 99 counted Oak Flat, which is no longer listed); motorhome 30 ft, trailer 24 ft; no hookups; flush toilets + pay showers; pin ~1.2 km off; phone added.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE creekside -> not waterfront (stored value is not --AWH). The 2018 park map puts Huckleberry (1-36) and Madrone (37-76) west of Highway 101, with the South Fork Eel River, swim beach and day-use area east of the highway; the ReserveCalifornia facility points sit ~350-400 m from the river channel under continuous canopy. A highway between sites and water rules out on-water, and no site is near enough for a view through the redwoods. (The South Fork Eel's wetted channel is ~20-30 m here, so 'creekside' was the right class only if some site were beside it - none is.) Old Oak Flat (sites 79-169), the only campground on the river, is no longer on ReserveCalifornia or the park page. Proposed evidence: 'parks.ca.gov 2018 park map + ReserveCalifornia facility points 2026-11-26: Huckleberry and Madrone are west of Hwy 101, 350-400 m from the South Fork Eel under canopy; Oak Flat (across the river) no longer offered.'
